properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two complete, parseable EC P-256 (secp256r1) private keys in PKCS#8 PEM, committed verbatim as unit-test fixture identities (fabric-gateway X509Identity for Wallets) in blockchain-fabric-admin — the same key material duplicated in both test files. Test-only, never a production key, but it is real committed key material and belongs in a key inventory; rotate by deleting, not by changing usage. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf ^1.0.0 (bcrypt-compatible PBKDF2 KDF) is declared in the npm lockfiles of four workspace packages (root, blockchain-extension, blockchain-ui, blockchain-website) as the transitive companion of tweetnacl (nacl secretbox key derivation) in the Fabric Node SDK dependency chain. Dependency inventory — what the build ships; no first-party call site found in application source. Changeable here by upgrading/removing the dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey (OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey — single-iteration MD5-based KDF, no salt stretching) is declared as a dev:true dependency in the extension and ui lockfiles, required by browserify-aes, browserify-cipher and parse-asn1 inside the webpack crypto-browserify polyfill chain. Build toolchain only; no application call site in this repo's own code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signing available via tweetnacl@0.14.5 pinned in the root lockfile — a capability of the shipped dependency tree (Fabric Node SDK chain), not a first-party call site. Quantum-unsafe signature under Shor; migrate to ML-DSA-65 on a schedule. Observable here, replaceable by bumping/removing the dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 scalar multiplication (nacl.box / crypto_scalarmult) available via tweetnacl@0.14.5 pinned in the root lockfile — capability of the shipped dependency tree, no first-party call site found. Classically breakable in retrospect once a CRQC exists; if used for session key agreement the migration is the X25519MLKEM768 hybrid. Observable here, replaceable by bumping the dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305-256 authenticated encryption via tweetnacl@0.14.5 (nacl.secretbox) pinned in the root lockfile. Symmetric AE — not weakened by Shor's algorithm; quantum-safe as recorded (rating A+). Dependency inventory entry for the shipped tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl 0.14.5 pinned as a transitive dependency of sshpk 1.16.1 (the http-signature chain used by the Fabric Node SDK) in the root lockfile, and in the blockchain-ui and blockchain-website lockfiles; carries XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox, X25519 and Ed25519. Capability of the shipped dependency tree; no first-party import found. The ALG-683d5cd2 (Ed25519), ALG-defedad1 (X25519) and ALG-f58a8f00 (XSalsa20-Poly1305) objects are the algorithms this same library provides.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge 0.10.0 vendored transitively via selfsigned@1.10.8 (webpack dev-server chain) in packages/blockchain-extension/package-lock.json; provides RSA, X.509 and PKCS#12 implementations in pure JS. Dev-only dependency inventory — what the dev toolchain ships; no first-party call site in extension source. Companion to LIB-b4358cea (selfsigned), the package that actually draws it in.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: golang.org/x/crypto v0.0.0-20181203042331-505ab145d0a9 declared in the Go module checksums (go.sum) of the vendored sample chaincode application (fab-car-mod) under blockchain-fabric-admin test data — a fixture Go app used by integration tests, not the shipped product. The x/crypto module provides classical primitives (SSH, bcrypt, scrypt, x509/ed25519 helpers). Observable here, replaceable only by updating the fixture's go.mod.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto dependency: golang.org/x/crypto v0.0.0-20181203042331-505ab145d0a9 in the same go.sum of the vendored fab-car-mod sample chaincode app under blockchain-fabric-admin test data. Same logical asset as ALG-2bf2e623 (the algorithm-package record for this library entry) — linked so a reader can reference one entry.
